baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a QuantGene 9600 Fluorescent Quantitative Detection System (FQD-96C). An automated standalone in vitro diagnostic instrument used for quantitative detection of analytes in pathogen nucleic acids from human samples using the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) process. It consists of a power supply, support, fixing plate, power supply switch, main printed circuit board, monitor, guide rail assembly, temperature control module, wires, and external components. The QuantGene 9600 Fluorescent Quantitative Detection System (FQD-96C) is assembled in Japan using components sourced from China.

The Power supply, Support, Power supply fixing plate, Power supply switch, Main printed circuit board, Monitor, Wires, Guide rail assembly, Temperature control module and External components are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Japan: Attach power supply to support with screws; Press power supply fixing plate against power supply switch and affix with glue; Fasten main board to the device with screws; Attach monitor with screws and plug wires into allocated slots; Power on monitor, verify serial number display, and slide guide rail assembly together with temperature control module fastened with screws and glue; Press all wires into place on the main printed circuit board; Fasten external components with screws and zip tie wires in place.

key_factors: Main printed circuit board, temperature control module, and complete Chinese subassemblies
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the main printed circuit board, temperature control module, and all other components in China
prediction.reasoning: All components of the PCR detection system, including the main PCB and temperature control module that impart its essential character, are wholly produced in China. Unlike the N331908 line of rulings where complex PCBA manufacturing (SMT and through-hole soldering) occurred in the final assembly country, the operations in Japan consist merely of simple mechanical assembly using screws, glue, and plug-in wires. This simple assembly does not result in a substantial transformation, so the country of origin remains China.

plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a QuantGene 9600 Fluorescent Quantitative Detection System (FQD-96C). An automated standalone in vitro diagnostic instrument used for quantitative detection of analytes in pathogen nucleic acids from human samples using the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) process. It consists of a power supply, support, fixing plate, power supply switch, main printed circuit board, monitor, guide rail assembly, temperature control module, wires, and external components. The QuantGene 9600 Fluorescent Quantitative Detection System (FQD-96C) is assembled in Japan using components sourced from Japan and China.

The Power supply, Power supply switch, Main printed circuit board, Monitor and Temperature control module are produced in Japan. The Support, Power supply fixing plate, Wires, Guide rail assembly and External components are sourced from China. 

In Japan, the Power supply, Power supply switch, Main printed circuit board, Monitor and Temperature control module will be produced in-house: populate printed circuit boards with electronic components using surface mount technology (SMT); manufacture and assemble LED emitters and photodetectors into optical sensor arrays; produce chip-on-board (COB) modules, LCD screens, and temperature or pressure sensor movements; load firmware and perform circuit board quality control testing (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

Final assembly in Japan: Attach power supply to support with screws; Press power supply fixing plate against power supply switch and affix with glue; Fasten main board to the device with screws; Attach monitor with screws and plug wires into allocated slots; Power on monitor, verify serial number display, and slide guide rail assembly together with temperature control module fastened with screws and glue; Press all wires into place on the main printed circuit board; Fasten external components with screws and zip tie wires in place.

key_factors: Main printed circuit board, temperature control module, monitor, and power supply
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing the critical electronic and optical subassemblies via SMT and performing final assembly in Japan
prediction.reasoning: In Japan, the most critical functional components—the main PCBA (via SMT), temperature control module, optical sensor arrays, monitor, and power supply—are manufactured from the ground up and programmed with firmware. Consistent with N331903, producing the core PCBAs via SMT and integrating them with structural housings (sourced from China) during final assembly substantially transforms the components into a new diagnostic instrument, conferring Japanese origin.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, all components are produced in China and undergo simple screw-and-glue final assembly in Japan, leaving origin in China. In Variant B, the functional core of the PCR detection system—including the main printed circuit board (via SMT), temperature control module, optical sensor arrays, monitor, power supply, and power switch—is manufactured in Japan, alongside final assembly. Under N330296, SMT production of the main PCBAs and functional electronic modules imparts the essential character of an electronic detection/imaging instrument. Unlike H304677 (where major functional subassemblies remained in China), only passive structural parts and wires remain Chinese in Variant B.
